documents.title: Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter Ended June 30, 2026
Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of Unaudited Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter Ended June 30, 2026

analysis.summary: Pix Transmissions Limited reported a marginal decline in consolidated total income to Rs. 59,977.44 lakhs and profit after tax to Rs. 10,688.72 lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. Management highlighted headwinds including raw material volatility linked to West Asian conflicts, Indian Rupee depreciation, domestic disruptions, and U.S. tariffs.

guidance.claim: The company stated that India's GDP growth is pegged at 6.3% in FY 2025-26.
guidance.quote: We continue to retain our position as the world’s fastest growing major economy with GDP growth pegged at 6.3% in FY 2025-26.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the company experienced heightened volatility in the prices of raw materials linked to crude due to the conflict in West Asia.
margins_costs.quote: Due to the current conflict in West Asia, not only are we experiencing heightened volatility in the prices of raw materials (linked to crude), but their availability also seems to be impacted.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that the depreciation in the Indian Rupee was pushing up the price of imports.
margins_costs.quote: To exacerbate matters, the depreciation in the Indian Rupee is also pushing up the price of imports.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that as a net exporter, the company was able to offset some of the cost impact by participating at favourable levels.
margins_costs.quote: However, being a net exporter, we are able to offset some of this impact by participating at favourable levels.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the company continued to pare down debt where possible while bolstering reserves.
capital_allocation.quote: Furthermore, we continue to pare down debt where possible whilst bolstering reserves.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of Rs. 9 per equity share of Rs. 10 each for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has recommended a final dividend of Rs. 9/- (90%) per equity share of Rs.10 each.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that uncertainty beginning in 2025 stretched into 2026 and was exacerbated by conflict in West Asia.
risks_headwinds.quote: The uncertainty that began in 2025 has not only stretched to 2026, but seems to have far surpassed it.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management reported disruption caused by events at home in May 2025 and the imposition of tariffs on products by the U.S.
risks_headwinds.quote: As a Company, we tried our level best to overcome some of the disruption caused by the events that unfolded at home in May ’25 as well as the imposition of tariffs on our products by the U.S.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that geopolitical conflicts and tariff wars pose volatility and uncertainty for global trade.
risks_headwinds.quote: In 2025, not only are we plagued with wars spanning geographies but the tariff-wars have added a whole new dimension to how countries will trade with each other in the times to come.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that they remain cautiously optimistic for the coming year.
management_commitments.quote: We remain cautiously optimistic for the coming year, and you can be rest assured that my team and I will work tirelessly to deliver the performance that you have now grown accustomed to.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to embark upon its solar power project shortly.
management_commitments.quote: Moreover, we will shortly be embarking upon our solar power project which is a testament to our commitment to sustainability.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
